column1: # Cases for require-subagent-sizing.sh — one per line: <verdict><TAB><tool_input JSON>
# verdict is `pass` (hook exits 0, no rewrite), `block` (hook exits 2), or
# `effort=<level>` (hook exits 0 and its updatedInput carries that effort), or `once`
# (sent with a session_id: the first call exits 2, the same call again exits 0).
# --- no model is the failure the hook exists for
# --- the built-in Explore and Plan types inherit the session model, so they need one too
# --- haiku and sonnet without an effort get the rule's value filled in
# --- an unknown model string is not this hook's business
# --- with a session_id the first call is refused once, even with a model set; the repeat passes
# --- opus or fable for a description that opens with a build verb is refused once per session and description
# (`once-after-first` is sent after the session's own first call has been used up, so only this check can refuse)
# a design or review description, or sonnet, or an unknown model string, is not refused
# punctuation, endings and irregular pasts still read as the build verb; an empty or non-verb description does not
# --- a build-verb spawn that is also the session's first call is refused once, not twice
